svg.text: THIS module: case, its own drawers / wheels, and scheduled doors.
Images show actual saved model geometry; exploded views are identification aids.
1. Build on the floor: Back, Sides, Bottom, Top, then THREE full-height dividers.
2. Fit FOUR separate shelves and the internal cable passages / LED profile.
3. Trial-fit the four doors using their scheduled hinge types; check gaps.
4. Install with lifting help and temporary support; fix to wall and neighbouring towers.
5. Do not release temporary support until the selected wall fixing arrangement is secure.
